n02.descriptionHtml:
A small sun rising at the throat. One round clear cubic zirconia of about 7mm sits up in gold claws, and seven slender polished gold tone petals fan out below it like rays, about 25mm across in all, on a fine snake chain.

STYLING TIP: Let it sit alone on a plain neckline, so the petals catch the light.

Details

  • Pendant: Approximately 25mm across, seven open polished petals fanned below the stone
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in a claw setting
  • Chain: Fine snake chain with a lobster clasp and extender
  • Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
